verification.scope: Reviewed 2026-10-20. Read the complete publisher chapter, printed pp.205–224, including all three kolam grammar descriptions, discussion and references. Visually checked the paired seeing/drawing rules in Fig.10 on p.219. The illustrated grammars omit control labels and preprocessing/postprocessing details. The performance model and temporal segmentations are conjectural; the chapter does not report a controlled practitioner study, measured timing or a complete account of kolam’s cultural meanings.
